title: One Primary Appraisal Order per Mortgage Loan File
content:
## Appraisal Order — one primary order per loan file

**Rule.** A Mortgage Loan File may carry only one Appraisal Order placed as a standard order, as a report transferred in from another lender, or as a new order after expiration, whose status is not cancelled. An order counts against this limit while its status is ordered, assigned, on hold, inspected, completed, delivered or under reconsideration. A cancelled order never blocks a new one.

**Further orders on the same file.** A second order on the same loan file is placed only:
- as a jumbo second appraisal, when the base loan amount is above the second-appraisal loan amount threshold of the primary report type; or
- as a higher-priced mortgage loan flip second appraisal, under the flip rule.

A replacement for an appraisal that aged past its usable life is ordered as a new order after expiration only after the expired order is cancelled or its age limit has passed.

**Basis of the check.** The limit is read from Larkspur's system record of the Appraisal Orders on the same loan file — their order reason and their status — before a new order is placed; the loan file of the new order is the file whose orders are read.

### Order reason and status — how the limit reads

| Existing order on the file | Its status | Does it block another standard, transferred-in or new-after-expiration order? |
|---|---|---|
| Standard order | delivered | Yes |
| Transferred-in report | on hold | Yes |
| New order after expiration | assigned | Yes |
| Any of the three | cancelled | No |

*Hypothetical case.* A file's standard order was cancelled before assignment; the file now carries no non-cancelled order of the three kinds, so the cancelled order does not stand in the way of a new standard order on that file.
